title: Nea Wɔapaw no a Ɔka Nsɛm no
intro: Wɔ bepɔw bi a ɔsoro nsɛm sian sian so sunsuma mu no, nkurɔfo bi gyidi wosow wɔ sika kɔkɔɔ a ɛhyerɛn ase. Ɔkra biako a wɔama no kasa mu nimdeɛ akyɛde no gyinaa hɔ sɛ mmoa ma asɛmpatrɛw kɛse bi, nanso ohyiaa sɔhwɛ a emu dɔ bere tiaa bi. Bere a ɔbɔfo a wɔapaw no no foro kɔɔ beae kronkron bi a wɔpaw no no, saa onipa yi kɔɔ so srɛɛ ɔman bi a na wɔn ho adwo no. Hena ne ɔkra a ogyina pintinn a ne nne sɔree tiaa abosonsom yi?
clues: Allah na ɔpaw me sɛ menyɛ nkɔmhyɛni, ɛwom sɛ wɔtaa ka m’asɛm no ka ɔfoforo ho de.
Wɔde me kɔɔ sodifo otirimɔdenfo bi nkyɛn, nanso na m’adwuma ne sɛ mɛboa, na ɛnyɛ sɛ mɛdi anim.
Ná wɔama me kasa mu nimdeɛ akyɛde, na na me nsɛm no atirimpɔw ne sɛ ɛbɛdwo koma.
Bere a me hokafo no fii hɔ kɔyɛɛ nhyehyɛe kronkron bi no, wogyaw me sɛ menkyerɛ nnipa a wɔn ho nyɛ den kwan.
Wɔ wɔn abotare a wonni mu no, wɔde wɔn agude no yɛɛ ohoni bi, na mesrɛɛ wɔn sɛ wɔntena hɔ mma Allah.
Me hokafo no san bae bɛkyeree me, nanso mekyerɛkyerɛɛ mu sɛ nkurɔfo no dii me so nkonim na ɛkaa kakraa bi na wokum me; Ná menka abɔnefo no ho.

trial.label: Sɔhwɛ/Asɛm a esii
options: Sikakɔkɔɔ nantwi ba asɛm a esii no anim
Ɔyare a emu yɛ den ho sɔhwɛ
Ahonyade ne mmofra a wɔbɛhwere ho sɔhwɛ
trial.answer: Sikakɔkɔɔ nantwi ba asɛm a esii no anim

outcome.label: Nsunsuansoɔ
options: Wɔde bɔne akyɛ no na wɔabu no bem
outcome.answer: Wɔde bɔne akyɛ no na wɔabu no bem

arabic: ثُمَّ بَعَثْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِم مُّوسَىٰ وَهَـٰرُونَ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِي۟هِۦ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ وَكَانُوا۟ قَوْمًۭا مُّجْرِمِينَ
verse: Then We sent after them Moses and Aaron to Pharaoh and his establishment with Our signs, but they behaved arrogantly and were a criminal people. (10:75)
